content: Multi-tab/multi-dimension reporting pages are commonly slow because each tab/dimension re-runs its own heavy join+aggregate query live (and sometimes N+1 per row) on every page load. Standard mitigation is precomputed/materialized summary tables refreshed on a schedule or on sync-completion event (not on every page view), so read-heavy public report pages hit small pre-aggregated tables instead of large join fan-outs at request time.
